elements.label: Root float starts 60px from top/left, sizes to its content, and is capped 60px from right/bottom.

elements.label: Child float header: "Enrollments" or "Enrollments for {parent title}" when drilled with context.

elements.label: Return the live row array for a panel.

elements.label: Cascade action only — V2 headers are ~32–36px; drill-down spawn still uses +24 in nextPos().

elements.label: True when this table-zone float has the highest z (root: panel=null).

elements.name: cascadePositionForSlot
elements.label: Slot 1 = nearest to root; higher slots step further down-right.

elements.label: Stagger drilled panels by current z-order: buried (low z) → least offset; front → most.

elements.label: New panel: bring to front (cascade runs via brought-to-front).

elements.label: Close drilled panels and all overlay dialogs; root WP Tables panel stays open.

elements.label: Form Dialog Go to — open related panel after save; caller awaits so data is loaded before dialog closes.

elements.label: Same row list the table shows: drilled panels use `_panelRows` when set (live ref), else `rows`.
